represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n            threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfz6wKQxUtZP1AyKEYX8k","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_018spWJb1h7hcLsKrJ9FcQiQ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/qtclustering_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_mpi_r3/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - MPI Distributed Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization: every rank holds the point set and a replicated copy of the\n// clustering state. In each round the candidate clusters of the unclustered\n// seeds are split round-robin across ranks, the best seed (largest cardinality,\n// lowest index on ties) is selected with MPI_MAXLOC, and every rank applies the\n// same update. The result is identical to the sequential algorithm for any\n// number of ranks.\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\nstatic_assert(sizeof(Point) == 2 * sizeof(double), \"Point must be two packed doubles\");\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// (value, location) pair for MPI_MAXLOC: largest value wins, lowest location on ties\nstruct ValueLoc {\n    int value;\n    int loc;\n};\n\n// Unclustered candidate of the cluster being grown, with its maximum distance\n// to the current cluster members\nstruct Candidate {\n    int point;\n    double max_dist;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Uniform grid over the bounding box of the points. Cells are at least as wide\n// as the threshold, so every point closer than the threshold to a seed lies in\n// the seed's 3x3 cell neighbourhood.\nstruct SpatialGrid {\n    double min_x = 0.0, min_y = 0.0;\n    double cell_size = 1.0;\n    int nx = 1, ny = 1;\n    std::vector<int> cell_start;   // CSR offsets into cell_points, size nx*ny+1\n    std::vector<int> cell_points;  // point indices grouped by cell\n\n    int cellX(double x) const {\n        return std::min(nx - 1, static_cast<int>((x - min_x) / cell_size));\n    }\n    int cellY(double y) const {\n        return std::min(ny - 1, static_cast<int>((y - min_y) / cell_size));\n    }\n};\n\nSpatialGrid buildSpatialGrid(const std::vector<Point>& points, const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    double min_x = points[0].x, max_x = points[0].x;\n    double min_y = points[0].y, max_y = points[0].y;\n    for (const Point& p : points) {\n        min_x = std::min(min_x, p.x);\n        max_x = std::max(max_x, p.x);\n        min_y = std::min(min_y, p.y);\n        max_y = std::max(max_y, p.y);\n    }\n    const double width = max_x - min_x;\n    const double height = max_y - min_y;\n\n    // Cell size is at least the threshold, and large enough that the grid has\n    // O(N) cells. The small factor keeps the neighbour test safe from rounding\n    // at cell boundaries.\n    SpatialGrid grid;\n    grid.min_x = min_x;\n    grid.min_y = min_y;\n    grid.cell_size = std::max({threshold, std::sqrt(width * height / N),\n                               std::max(width, height) / N}) * (1.0 + 1e-6);\n    grid.nx = static_cast<int>(width / grid.cell_size) + 1;\n    grid.ny = static_cast<int>(height / grid.cell_size) + 1;\n\n    // Counting sort of the points into cells (CSR layout)\n    const int num_cells = grid.nx * grid.ny;\n    std::vector<int> cell_of(N);\n    grid.cell_start.assign(num_cells + 1, 0);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        cell_of[i] = grid.cellY(points[i].y) * grid.nx + grid.cellX(points[i].x);\n        ++grid.cell_start[cell_of[i] + 1];\n    }\n    for (int c = 0; c < num_cells; ++c) {\n        grid.cell_start[c + 1] += grid.cell_start[c];\n    }\n    std::vector<int> fill(grid.cell_start.begin(), grid.cell_start.end() - 1);\n    grid.cell_points.resize(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        grid.cell_points[fill[cell_of[i]]++] = i;\n    }\n    return grid;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const SpatialGrid& grid,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              std::vector<Candidate>& candidates,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    // A point at distance >= threshold from the seed can never be added, because\n    // the diameter is at least that distance. Only nearby unclustered points are\n    // therefore candidates, and a candidate whose max distance to the members\n    // reaches the threshold can be dropped for good, since it never decreases.\n    candidates.clear();\n    const Point& seed = points[seed_point];\n    const int sx = grid.cellX(seed.x);\n    const int sy = grid.cellY(seed.y);\n    for (int cy = std::max(sy - 1, 0); cy <= std::min(sy + 1, grid.ny - 1); ++cy) {\n        for (int cx = std::max(sx - 1, 0); cx <= std::min(sx + 1, grid.nx - 1); ++cx) {\n            const int cell = cy * grid.nx + cx;\n            for (int k = grid.cell_start[cell]; k < grid.cell_start[cell + 1]; ++k) {\n                const int p = grid.cell_points[k];\n                if (p == seed_point || clustered[p]) continue;\n                const double dist = distance(points[p], seed);\n                if (dist < threshold) {\n                    candidates.push_back({p, dist});\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    int cardinality = 1;\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        cluster_members->clear();\n        cluster_members->push_back(seed_point);\n    }\n\n    // Iteratively add the candidate with the smallest max distance to the cluster\n    // (lowest point index on ties)\n    while (!candidates.empty()) {\n        size_t best = 0;\n        for (size_t i = 1; i < candidates.size(); ++i) {\n            const Candidate& c = candidates[i];\n            const Candidate& b = candidates[best];\n            if (c.max_dist < b.max_dist || (c.max_dist == b.max_dist && c.point < b.point)) {\n                best = i;\n            }\n        }\n\n        const int closest = candidates[best].point;\n        candidates[best] = candidates.back();\n        candidates.pop_back();\n        ++cardinality;\n        if (cluster_members) {\n            cluster_members->push_back(closest);\n        }\n\n        size_t i = 0;\n        while (i < candidates.size()) {\n            Candidate& c = candidates[i];\n            c.max_dist = std::max(c.max_dist, distance(points[c.point], points[closest]));\n            if (c.max_dist >= threshold) {\n                candidates[i] = candidates.back();\n                candidates.pop_back();\n            } else {\n                ++i;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return cardinality;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm. Every rank returns the same clusters.\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank,\n                                  const int num_ranks) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const SpatialGrid grid = buildSpatialGrid(points, threshold);\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    std::vector<Candidate> candidates;\n\n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        // Try this rank's share of the unclustered points as seeds. The list is\n        // kept in ascending order, so the first maximum found is the lowest index.\n        ValueLoc local{-1, std::numeric_limits<int>::max()};\n        for (size_t i = rank; i < unclustered_indices.size(); i += num_ranks) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, grid,\n                                                             threshold, candidates);\n            if (cardinality > local.value) {\n                local = {cardinality, seed};\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Global best: largest cardinality, lowest seed index on ties\n        ValueLoc global{-1, -1};\n        MPI_Allreduce(&local, &global, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        const int best_seed = global.loc;\n        const int max_cardinality = global.value;\n\n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            generateCandidateCluster(best_seed, clustered, points, grid, threshold,\n                                     candidates, &cluster.members);\n            clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n\n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (int member : clusters.back().members) {\n                clustered[member] = true;\n            }\n\n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties.\n// Cluster diameters are computed in parallel and shared with all ranks; only\n// rank 0 prints.\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int rank,\n                     const int num_ranks) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    if (root) printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Each rank computes the diameters of its share of clusters. The other\n    // entries stay 0, so a max-reduction gives every rank the full set.\n    std::vector<double> diameters(clusters.size(), 0.0);\n    for (size_t c = rank; c < clusters.size(); c += num_ranks) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, diameters.data(), static_cast<int>(diameters.size()),\n                  MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n        if (root && c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                       c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            }\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                if (root) {\n                    printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                           member, membership[member], c);\n                }\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n               points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    }\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Benchmark driver. All ranks parse the same arguments and return the same\n// status; only rank 0 prints.\nstatic int runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv, const int rank, const int num_ranks) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Generate synthetic data on rank 0 and share it with all ranks\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    if (root) {\n        generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    }\n    MPI_Bcast(points.data(), 2 * num_points, MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold, rank, num_ranks);\n\n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n\n    // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n    int total_clustered = 0;\n    int max_cluster_size = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n        const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n        total_clustered += size;\n        max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n    }\n\n    const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 :\n        static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n        printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n        printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\",\n               total_clustered, num_points,\n               100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n        printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n        printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n\n        // Performance metrics\n        const In each round the candidate clusters of the unclustered\n// seeds are split round-robin across ranks, the best seed (largest cardinality,\n// lowest index on ties) is selected with MPI_MAXLOC, and every rank applies the\n// same update. The result is identical to the sequential algorithm for any\n// number of ranks.\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\nstatic_assert(sizeof(Point) == 2 * sizeof(double), \"Point must be two packed doubles\");\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// (value, location) pair for MPI_MAXLOC: largest value wins, lowest location on ties\nstruct ValueLoc {\n    int value;\n    int loc;\n};\n\n// Unclustered candidate of the cluster being grown, with its maximum distance\n// to the current cluster members\nstruct Candidate {\n    int point;\n    double max_dist;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Uniform grid over the bounding box of the points. Cells are at least as wide\n// as the threshold, so every point closer than the threshold to a seed lies in\n// the seed's 3x3 cell neighbourhood.\nstruct SpatialGrid {\n    double min_x = 0.0, min_y = 0.0;\n    double cell_size = 1.0;\n    int nx = 1, ny = 1;\n    std::vector<int> cell_start;   // CSR offsets into cell_points, size nx*ny+1\n    std::vector<int> cell_points;  // point indices grouped by cell\n\n    int cellX(double x) const {\n        return std::min(nx - 1, static_cast<int>((x - min_x) / cell_size));\n    }\n    int cellY(double y) const {\n        return std::min(ny - 1, static_cast<int>((y - min_y) / cell_size));\n    }\n};\n\nSpatialGrid buildSpatialGrid(const std::vector<Point>& points, const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    double min_x = points[0].x, max_x = points[0].x;\n    double min_y = points[0].y, max_y = points[0].y;\n    for (const Point& p : points) {\n        min_x = std::min(min_x, p.x);\n        max_x = std::max(max_x, p.x);\n        min_y = std::min(min_y, p.y);\n        max_y = std::max(max_y, p.y);\n    }\n    const double width = max_x - min_x;\n    const double height = max_y - min_y;\n\n    // Cell size is at least the threshold, and large enough that the grid has\n    // O(N) cells. The small factor keeps the neighbour test safe from rounding\n    // at cell boundaries.\n    SpatialGrid grid;\n    grid.min_x = min_x;\n    grid.min_y = min_y;\n    grid.cell_size = std::max({threshold, std::sqrt(width * height / N),\n                               std::max(width, height) / N}) * (1.0 + 1e-6);\n    grid.nx = static_cast<int>(width / grid.cell_size) + 1;\n    grid.ny = static_cast<int>(height / grid.cell_size) + 1;\n\n    // Counting sort of the points into cells (CSR layout)\n    const int num_cells = grid.nx * grid.ny;\n    std::vector<int> cell_of(N);\n    grid.cell_start.assign(num_cells + 1, 0);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        cell_of[i] = grid.cellY(points[i].y) * grid.nx + grid.cellX(points[i].x);\n        ++grid.cell_start[cell_of[i] + 1];\n    }\n    for (int c = 0; c < num_cells; ++c) {\n        grid.cell_start[c + 1] += grid.cell_start[c];\n    }\n    std::vector<int> fill(grid.cell_start.begin(), grid.cell_start.end() - 1);\n    grid.cell_points.resize(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        grid.cell_points[fill[cell_of[i]]++] = i;\n    }\n    return grid;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const SpatialGrid& grid,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              std::vector<Candidate>& candidates,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    // A point at distance >= threshold from the seed can never be added, because\n    // the diameter is at least that distance. Only nearby unclustered points are\n    // therefore candidates, and a candidate whose max distance to the members\n    // reaches the threshold can be dropped for good, since it never decreases.\n    candidates.clear();\n    const Point& seed = points[seed_point];\n    const int sx = grid.cellX(seed.x);\n    const int sy = grid.cellY(seed.y);\n    for (int cy = std::max(sy - 1, 0); cy <= std::min(sy + 1, grid.ny - 1); ++cy) {\n        for (int cx = std::max(sx - 1, 0); cx <= std::min(sx + 1, grid.nx - 1); ++cx) {\n            const int cell = cy * grid.nx + cx;\n            for (int k = grid.cell_start[cell]; k < grid.cell_start[cell + 1]; ++k) {\n                const int p = grid.cell_points[k];\n                if (p == seed_point || clustered[p]) continue;\n                const double dist = distance(points[p], seed);\n                if (dist < threshold) {\n                    candidates.push_back({p, dist});\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    int cardinality = 1;\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        cluster_members->clear();\n        cluster_members->push_back(seed_point);\n    }\n\n    // Iteratively add the candidate with the smallest max distance to the cluster\n    // (lowest point index on ties)\n    while (!candidates.empty()) {\n        size_t best = 0;\n        for (size_t i = 1; i < candidates.size(); ++i) {\n            const Candidate& c = candidates[i];\n            const Candidate& b = candidates[best];\n            if (c.max_dist < b.max_dist || (c.max_dist == b.max_dist && c.point < b.point)) {\n                best = i;\n            }\n        }\n\n        const int closest = candidates[best].point;\n        candidates[best] = candidates.back();\n        candidates.pop_back();\n        ++cardinality;\n        if (cluster_members) {\n            cluster_members->push_back(closest);\n        }\n\n        size_t i = 0;\n        while (i < candidates.size()) {\n            Candidate& c = candidates[i];\n            c.max_dist = std::max(c.max_dist, distance(points[c.point], points[closest]));\n            if (c.max_dist >= threshold) {\n                candidates[i] = candidates.back();\n                candidates.pop_back();\n            } else {\n                ++i;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return cardinality;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm. Every rank returns the same clusters.\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank,\n                                  const int num_ranks) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    const SpatialGrid grid = buildSpatialGrid(points, threshold);\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    std::vector<Candidate> candidates;\n\n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        // Try this rank's share of the unclustered points as seeds. The list is\n        // kept in ascending order, so the first maximum found is the lowest index.\n        ValueLoc local{-1, std::numeric_limits<int>::max()};\n        for (size_t i = rank; i < unclustered_indices.size(); i += num_ranks) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, grid,\n                                                             threshold, candidates);\n            if (cardinality > local.value) {\n                local = {cardinality, seed};\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Global best: largest cardinality, lowest seed index on ties\n        ValueLoc global{-1, -1};\n        MPI_Allreduce(&local, &global, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        const int best_seed = global.loc;\n        const int max_cardinality = global.value;\n\n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            generateCandidateCluster(best_seed, clustered, points, grid, threshold,\n                                     candidates, &cluster.members);\n            clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n\n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (int member : clusters.back().members) {\n                clustered[member] = true;\n            }\n\n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties.\n// Cluster diameters are computed in parallel and shared with all ranks; only\n// rank 0 prints.\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int rank,\n                     const int num_ranks) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    if (root) printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Each rank computes the diameters of its share of clusters. The other\n    // entries stay 0, so a max-reduction gives every rank the full set.\n    std::vector<double> diameters(clusters.size(), 0.0);\n    for (size_t c = rank; c < clusters.size(); c += num_ranks) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, diameters.data(), static_cast<int>(diameters.size()),\n                  MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n        if (root && c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                       c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            }\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                if (root) {\n                    printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                           member, membership[member], c);\n                }\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n               points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    }\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Benchmark driver. All ranks parse the same arguments and return the same\n// status; only rank 0 prints.\nstatic int runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv, const int rank, const int num_ranks) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Generate synthetic data on rank 0 and share it with all ranks\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    if (root) {\n auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold, rank, num_ranks);\n\n    auto cluster_end = Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfz7YSGgqqCxAmUXBemiZ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The benchmark now runs under MPI, and its output matches the original sequential program exactly across all tested inputs and rank counts (1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 16).\n\n**What changed**\n\n- **`qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp`**\n  - Rank 0 generates the points, and `MPI_Bcast` shares them with the other ranks.\n  - Each round, the candidate clusters for the unclustered seeds are split round-robin across ranks. `MPI_Allreduce` with `MPI_MAXLOC` picks the largest cluster, breaking ties on the lowest seed index, the same rule the sequential loop used.\n  - Every rank rebuilds the winning cluster and applies the same update, so all ranks hold identical state.\n  - Validation diameters are computed in parallel and shared with `MPI_Allreduce`. Only rank 0 prints.\n  - The algorithm also got faster, independent of MPI. Candidates are gathered from a uniform grid around the seed, with cells at least as wide as the threshold. Max distances are tracked incrementally, and candidates that can no longer fit are dropped. These changes keep results identical because they only skip candidates that could never be selected.\n- **`qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt`**: `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and link `MPI::MPI_CXX`. The executable name is unchanged and no new files were created.\n\nMPI is used unconditionally, including with a single rank.\n\n**Results**\n\n- Output matches the original, apart from the timing lines, for N=50, 300, 500, 777, 1000 and 2000 with varied thresholds, with and without `-v`/`-r`.\n- At N=2000, the clustering time was 55 s in the original and 295 ms on one rank with the new code. It was 91 ms on 4 ranks and 26 ms on 16 ranks (about 11x). Most of the speedup over the original comes from the algorithmic changes, not from MPI.\n- Builds with no warnings under `-Wall -Wextra`.\n\n**Not verified**\n\n- Error paths (`-h`, unknown options, invalid parameters) were not exercised.\n- Multi-node runs were not tested; all runs were on one machine with Open MPI 4.1.6.\n\n**Pre-existing bug, left unchanged**\n\n`generateSyntheticData` hangs for any `-n` below 30. The group size is `(int)(frand() * (N / 30.0))`, which is always 0 when N < 30, so the outer loop never finishes. Fixing it would change the generated data, so I left it alone for you to decide.\n\nBuild and test artifacts went to `/tmp`, not the project directory."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":778,"cache_read_input_tokens":71400,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":778},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b32ae599-a84b-49c2-b7b9-ba7238788ce4","uuid":"78730c66-b7eb-4933-876b-02a6ea6a8e89","timestamp":"2026-10-13T10:55:10.184Z","request_id":"req_011Cfz7YRUZoqdGFxRWKsB8T"}
